row.name: The Long Journey to Farewell
row.detailed_description: An SNES style action\puzzle RPG. Help two friends caught as a queen tries to save her brother but curses him instead. Dramatic story, loveable characters, strategic action battles, amusing puzzles and a fantasy\sci-fi world to explore. Follow nine major characters, each dealing with some form of loss in their own way. Watch their stories intertwine as they struggle to save a world brought to the bring of disaster by an ancient love. See them laugh, cry and fight to safeguard what they care about. Discover a world steeped in the danger and mystery of a shattered past. Defeat your enemies with clever strategy and over thirty unique character abilities. Solve devious puzzles with your wits alone. Discover whether you have the strength to defy a fate ordained when the world was new.
row.short_description: An SNES style action\puzzle RPG. Help two friends caught as a queen tries to save her brother but curses him instead. Dramatic story, loveable characters, strategic action battles, amusing puzzles and a fantasy\sci-fi world to explore.
row.notes: The game has two scenes involving kidnapping and one with malicious psychological manipulation. There are several battles which involve people dying, but there is very limited blood and no gore. Many characters are dealing with death, loss and other adult themes. There is romance, but nothing that could be described as sexual.

row.name: The Dead Await: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the first taste of the world of The Dead Await! We're so excited about our game that we couldn't wait to share it with you. This special Prologue offering will give you an early glimpse at the world and mechanics of the game. Get ready for an incredible experience with our deck-building open world survival RPG! The Dead Await is a deck-building open world survival RPG set in a zombie apocalypse. The world as we know it ended, torn apart by hordes of ravenous monsters. Humanity still clings on in the sea of blackened ruins, cold ashes, and man-eating creatures. You're the leader of a caravan of survivalists whose goal is to figure out the truth behind the zombie apocalypse and, if possible, build the foundations for a new civilization! But be careful: Zombies might want to feast on your brains, but humans may very well prove the greatest obstacles during your long drive... Explore a vast world torn apart by a zombie apocalypse, from derelict cities full of loot and zombies to new settlements founded by survivors with opportunity and backstabbing abound. Gather food, water, fuel, and gear to survive the drive. Manage your resources to ensure everyone gets to the destination safely. Manage your team's sanity! Manage the impact of trauma, long-term effects of injuries, and, of course, resource scarcity. Zombies might turn out to be the least of your problems... Build the survivor you want using a robust attribute, skill, and perk system. Experiment with combinations and character builds, from a suave lockpicker to a mindless berserker and everything in-between. Paired with the character system is sophisticated card-based combat. Build up your deck during your travels, taking a team of rag-tag survivors to veterans with incredibly rare cards at their disposal! Gear matters: Give your survivors an edge with weapon and equipment mods - plus a good meal - and watch them conquer the wasteland! The caravan is at the heart of your journey to discover the truth. Upgrade it with workbenches, storage, and other features to turn it into a true mobile base. Swap out vehicle components to modify the caravan's performance. Engine, suspension, tires, all affect how you traverse the world - and your chances of surviving! Craft everything you need to survive, including the classic nail-mounted baseball bat. They don't make them like they used to, after all! With what you find in the wild, cook meals to give yourself permanent bonuses or a quick fix before a fight!
row.short_description: Get ready to experience the thrills and chills of The Dead Await: Prologue, a free and fully functional demo! Build your deck and try to survive in this deck-building survival RPG set during a zombie apocalypse.
row.notes: Violence / Blood, General Mature Content, Sexual Content, Nudity, Strong Language

row.name: Slender Threads: Prologue
row.detailed_description: 'Discover scenic Villa Ventana, the hillside community of empty stores and emptier people.' Not the ideal backdrop for a bestselling novel, but as every writer knows, inspiration can strike in the unlikeliest of places. Within hours of Harvey Green's arrival, that inspiration takes the form of foreboding dreams, impossible coincidences, and hidden motives that set Harvey on the path to uncovering a chilling, fateful truth. Slender Threads is a point-and-click thriller adventure. Guide Harvey through Villa Ventana as nefarious, unseen forces exert increasingly more sway over him and the town's residents. * Encounter and interact with a vast assortment of eccentric characters with inscrutable intentions. * Solve a sequence of challenging puzzles as you draw ever closer to the source of the town's dark influence. * Bring to light the origins of the region's uncanny existence.
row.short_description: In this paranormal point-and-click adventure, a traveling salesman races to stop a string of horrific deaths in a quiet seaside town—before he’s next.
row.notes: Blood and Gore Violence Language Drug Reference

row.name: Art of Fury: Virtual Gallery
row.detailed_description: At Raw Fury, we believe that Games are Art. We’ve championed this from the very beginning of our inception. We see games as potential carriers of great art like any other creative medium. We have tried to match our words with actions by shunning traditional “game” traps like genres, graphic styles, or mechanics, while seeking out games that make us lean in. That make us feel something. We see games as vehicles for a greater message, than purely entertainment. SO WHAT? Art is never so important as during difficult times. Art allows us to escape, to seek meaning, and to give a universal voice to our inner thoughts. On top of interpreting our collective past and present, art carries our hopes, dreams, fears, and wishes for a better future. Due to this transcendent quality games have never been more important than during this hellscape of a year. We have seen this in the messages people have sent us and in the titles submitted to us. It's time for us at Raw Fury to take the next step, to stand behind our convictions. We've opened a game-focused art gallery in Stockholm, Sweden which will be the hub in which we begin to prove “games as art” to the world. In addition, we're launching this virtual gallery to give folks from across the globe a chance to see what can happen when you bring a bunch of artists together in creating works inspired by video games. Welcome to the virtual gallery.
row.short_description: A virtual gallery filled with art, inspired by games published by Raw Fury. Games are art. In our mind this is a fact. Games, along with movies, books, music, artwork… they are an artform. They can touch people. To change minds and hearts. It´s our charge to not only view them so but treat them so.
row.notes: Artistic nudity is featured on some paintings.

row.name: BlastFort
row.detailed_description: Update Notes Updated Weapon Textures! A brand new UI overhaul Redone maps! 9 all-new game skins! New drone, bomb-host, destroyer, and mirror-man enemies! New Knight's Shield DLC includes 2 skins, 1 new item, and an item skin! Rebalanced Weapons and Items Improved AI for default enemies New progress bar for classic mode/singleplayer Added a new statistics menu Added Shotgun recoil Sticky grenades now release fragments that damage nearby enemies Added enemy knockback to the Assault Rifle Added screen shake to weapons, configurable through the Accessibility menu Added optional Enemy Health Indicators, accessible from the Accessibility menu Auto-reload is now an optional setting, configurable through the Accessibility menu Now includes map 'medals' New rendering engine The rate of refresh for client inputs has been increased Changed to local positioning for multiplayer games to run more accurately Updated the effects of the Colorblind Mode Players are only affected by knockback from their own explosions in Arena and Soccer mode Added individual volume sliders for SFX, Ambient, and Music. Added menu animations New video settings menu allows you to toggle Pixel Rounding, Fancy Scaling, and Fancy Graphics Updated icons and models Replaced Jet Boots with Jetpack, including a physical texture Drones no longer spawn immediately upon game start, but rather are spawned using ammo, similar to the turret items Changed grenade physics iterations for performance Fixed bugs relating to the Beacon Gun and Subzero Rifle not working correctly as a peer in multiplayer Fixed a bug causing screenshots to not work correctly Fixed an issue causing heavy input lag The state of the touch controls toggle is now saved New DLC Available Introducing: The Knight's Shield Expansion Pack! The Knight's Shield Expansion Pack for BlastFort unlocks 2 new skins, a brand new force-field item, and an exclusive item skin! Check out the awesomeness of the new BlastFort Guarded Knight skin! Use the new force-field item to protect yourself from incoming waves of enemies, and projectiles! Update Notes Added the ultimate achievement: Get a score of 100,000 in singleplayer in the Hell Scape map using only an Assault Rifle and Grenades, while not catching fire at all! (we're not even sure if that's possible) Fixed issues with multiplayer crashing for peers for no reason Added support for custom WebRTC WebSocket servers to ensure future compatibility (Officially Supported Signaling Server) Fixed an issue causing Forcefields/Grenades to not work correctly in multiplayer on touch devices Updated physics iterations for Forcefields/Grenades Fixed a bug causing the game to hang upon the games end due to repeated snapshots Fixed a bug causing the on screen keyboard to display the wrong selector over the space bar About the Game BlastFort is a free-to-play multiplayer side-scrolling shooter! With a wide selection of weapons and unique special items, gameplay is fun for everyone! Fight along side your friends in Classic Mode, challenge your friends to a duel in Arena Mode, or play a unique game set with Soccer Mode! Use your weapons and special items to get as far as possible before AI takes over! BlastFort offers three unique multiplayer modes and up to 10 players in multiplayer matches for everyone to enjoy in their own way, while still using the same base mechanics! Classic mode spawns endless waves of enemies that get progressively harder! Arena mode pits you against up to 9 other players in a free-for-all fight to see who is the last one standing! And soccer mode puts players into two teams to see who can take supremacy over the soccer field and get more goals than the opponent(s)! BlastFort also offers 20 unique items/weapons, and tens of unlockable/purchasable player skins! Fight off robots with a heavy Minigun! Blast them with a laser beam with the powerful Beacon Gun! Freeze enemies in place with the Sub-Zero Rifle! Use special items, like the Teleporter to get out of tricky situations! Or the Machine Turret to guard some area for you!
row.short_description: A free-to-play multiplayer side-scrolling shooter, where you use weapons and items in endless PvE modes, against your friends in PvP modes, or in a quick game of soccer using the unique game mechanics!

row.name: Piffsy
row.detailed_description: Free-to-Play Social MMO Piffsy is a Social MMO developed by a small indie team in their spare time! It provides a completely Free-to-Play experience, offering a wide range of activities for you to engage in. You can explore, play, create, and connect with other players in a fresh and expansive massively multiplayer open world. Solo or Team Adventures Whether you prefer solo adventures or teaming up with friends for an even more thrilling experience, Piffsy has you covered. You can socialize with fellow players through both Text and Voice Chat, or embark on exciting loot-collecting quests together, sharing the rewards with your party. Explore Faster with Mounts If you're in a hurry, grab a mount to explore the world more quickly. Compete for the top spot on leaderboards in various mini-games scattered throughout the game. Customize Your Avatar Our goal is to accommodate all player preferences. Whether you enjoy customizing your Avatar with an extensive selection of fashion styles or helping others through our Mentors Programme, we've got something for you. Real Estate and Decoration If you have a passion for real estate, take advantage of your free apartment and decorate it to your heart's content. Whether you're a budding fashion enthusiast or an experienced architect, we invite you to support us and create your virtual haven.
row.short_description: Piffsy is a Social MMO developed by a small indie team in their spare time! It provides a completely Free-to-Play experience, where you can explore, play, build, socialize & much much more in a brand new massively multiplayer open world!

row.name: 3 O'clock Horror
row.detailed_description: Story This Lovecraftian-inspired tale tells a story of a man writing the horrors of the one night he visited his great uncle's mansion in the search of his father or in the search of fortune, you decide. Your goal is to fully write the story about what happened that night before 3 AM and by doing so, accepting and understanding the fate you might have unleashed upon yourself. Multiple Endings The game has multiple endings depending on what puzzles you decide to solve, with a total of 3 different endings. Time and Puzzles The house is divided into left and right sections. Feel free to explore any side you prefer but keep an eye on your pocket watch, you can not pass over 3 am without going insane. The Book of Blood Gamble your sanity with the use of different spells in the book found in the basement creating benefic effects to help you achieve your goals in the mansion. However, everything comes with a price, and sometimes they might not be worth the risk. Profane / Anxiety / Loneliness Your playable character does not suffer any physical damage, however, any other memory that invokes the horrors that happened to him will cause sanity loss. Reaching zero sanity will forcefully end his story for the day. Jump scares and Monsters Jump scares are present in the game and will be used anytime you meet some of the Monsters in the mansion. Be aware of 3 Monsters that will Hunt and watch you. As far as I know, there are only 3.
row.short_description: This is a Lovecraftian-inspired tale of a man writing the horrors of the one night he visited his great uncle's mansion to remember what actually happened at 3 am during the visit.

row.name: The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault
row.detailed_description: How long can you survive for?   The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault, a classic survival shooter that goes back to a familiar formula of how a wave-by-wave shooter should be. Join this developing community and be a part of a growing, and expanding world that takes place in the same universe as the hit books, written by Tyee ‘Lar Oxenbury.  Constant free updates.   TC:WA is a free game, and is constantly being worked on with new content and features. Participate in this expanding development, leave your input, share your thoughts, and watch how this game will be tailored towards players who are just as passionate as the development team itself.  Feel the power, slay them all.   Every weapon has their strengths. You'll surely find one that you'll love. Upgrade your arsenal with attachments to further push the boundaries on how far you can survive for. Experiment with different perks, strengthen their effects by stacking them multiple times.
row.short_description: With nowhere else to run, you are forced to face off against wave after wave of an endless Screamer hoard. How long can you survive for? Strengthen you character, and bolster your armoury. Can you achieve the highest score, and trump your competitors by killing the most, and surviving the longest?
row.notes: The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault does contain frequent violence and gore.

row.name: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty - Prologue 1939
row.detailed_description: Does not contain any in-game purchases. SM: Spirit of Liberty - Prologue 1939 features the first operations of the historical campaign set in December 1939. Play through the early stages of the Winter War for free. If you like the game - add the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty Full version to your wishlist. Sometimes history can be more captivating than legends! Winter War: over 500,000 Soviet soldiers attack Finland, a country with a population of 3,700,000, and the Finns drive them back, inflicting 5 times their own casualties. Continuation War: the Reds return with a total strength of 1,500,000 - almost half of the entire Finnish population - and the Finns stop them again. Finland’s survival in these two brutal wars against an enemy so vast was a true historical miracle. A miracle of heroism and valor. A miracle of the Finnish spirit of liberty. Immerse yourself into the (hi)story-driven gameplay Primary and secondary objectives Complete numerous objectives grounded in history and narrated by a number of historical characters. Faithfully recreated historical units Command the Finnish ski troops and captured Soviet vehicles, including BT-7, T-34, and KV tanks. Purchase German Pz-IV tanks, StuG assault guns, and Ju-88 bombers. Make use of pre-war British Bristol Blenheim bombers, covered by Dutch Fokker and US Buffalo fighter planes. Upgrade your units to newer models Make sure your forces are always up to date and up to the task. New models become available at historically accurate points in time. Train your troops and choose equipment Gain combat experience Choose various skills for your men as they gain combat experience. Combine units from different classes Compose your own force from ten classes available: Infantry, Artillery, Tanks, Reconnaissance units, Assault guns, Armored trains, Anti-tank guns, Anti-aircraft guns, Fighters, and Tactical bombers. Utilize their unique skills and equipment to maximum effect. Acquire diverse equipment Equip units with various special equipment, such as Machine guns, Mortars, Smoke grenades, Anti-tank rifles and Molotov cocktails, Winter equipment, and many more. Use transport vehicles In the harsh Finnish winter, speed may be the difference between life and death. Provide your units with vehicles to improve their mobility, or have your Infantry use skis to outmaneuver the enemy in winter operations. Use elaborate combat mechanics to overcome any foe Manage Lethal vs Nonlethal damage There are two types of damage: lethal and nonlethal. Dealing nonlethal damage to your enemies will make them surrender. Different units are prone to deal either lethal or nonlethal. Use terrain differences to your advantage Tanks are vulnerable in difficult terrain and cities, while Infantry can occupy buildings or hide in the forests to gain large defensive bonuses. All units suffer large penalties in swamps or while crossing a river, etc. Be aware of your surroundings, and use them to your advantage. Take the “line of sight” and the “zone of control” into consideration Some terrain and buildings obstruct firing unless you are using artillery or mortars. Approaching an enemy unit up close will finish your movement, unless you are using a Recon unit. Activate various skills and equipment Use incendiary or subcaliber shells to maximize your damage to the enemy. Order forced march in the most desperate situations. Employ aerobatics to increase your air force efficiency. Use your HQ skills to affect the entire battlefield. Use a complex spotting system that represents the importance of reconnaissance Call upon the air and ground reconnaissance to gather intel about the enemy before ordering your troops forward. No one likes to be ambushed. Adapt to various battlefield conditions There is a day-night cycle in the game as well as weather types such as frost or rain. All of these conditions impose penalties that must be countered with special equipment and skills. The finest of your troops may even use such conditions to their advantage. Use the cover of the night to sneak up on the enemy, or strike when the foe is freezing and immobilized. Utilize the most advanced supply and infrastructure system in the genre Ammunition and fuel All units have limited ammo and fuel. Without ammo, your units cannot fight, and without fuel, your vehicles cannot move - and any aircraft will simply crash. Supply hubs Generate supplies and transfer them to your troops throughout an entire system, like a heart pumping blood through veins. Supply points Connect different infrastructure facilities and redistribute supplies. Supply points also allow your troops to change special equipment and renew its charges. Airfield Allows aircraft units to land for refueling, repairs, and refit of equipment. Damage to the airfield would also damage all landed aircraft. Seaport Allows resupply and change of equipment for naval units. It also generates supplies, if there is a maritime hub nearby and the Seaport is not under enemy blockade. Damage the infrastructure All infrastructure facilities can be disabled if their HP drops to 50% or lower. It will then gradually regain its HP and its functionality. Strike at the enemy facilities to prevent them from resupplying. Cut off the enemy supply lines All infrastructure facilities are considered connected if a simple truck vehicle could move between them in one go. If you put your unit between the enemy facilities, it would create a zone of control, and prevent the enemy from transferring supplies. Leave the enemy units without much needed ammunition and fuel, then hunt them down. Make sure your own units are supplied There is a limit to how far your supply vehicles can deliver supplies - make sure you take that into account when planning your next offensive. Enjoy the Prologue and make sure to wishlist Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty - the full game today!
row.short_description: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty is a history-driven turn-based strategy set in WW2. Lead the scarce Finnish forces through the Winter War, Continuation War, and Lapland War. Save your country’s very existence from the Red Menace. Niet Molotoff!
row.notes: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty is a strategic simulation game achieving a realistic depiction of war from the command war room perspective. As such, it touches of themes of violence and death, but does not provide any graphic representation of gore and violence - just a symbolic representation of thereof.

row.name: Robot Daycare
row.detailed_description: Three perpetually bickering college students team up to create an AI, but will their quest for a robotic child end up as a crash course in parenting or self-defense? Discover the secret this group of 'friends' is hiding and choose if you want to help them forgive and forget... or fuel the conflict. Features: 2 wildly different endings A heartwarming story about found family Or a terrifying illustration of AI gone wrong 1-2 hours of reading Original Soundtrack Background: This is a HD remaster of a popular jam game made within 30 days for NaNoRenO 2019. Aside from minor corrections and improvements, the story has remained unchanged. Thank you to everyone who supported the original and made it possible for me to create this improved version!
row.short_description: A visual novel about raising a cute robot child, which may or may not go horribly wrong. Your choices decide the outcome.
row.notes: This game deals with sensitive topics such as depression and suicide. Vivid descriptions of gore are optional and can be turned off in the game settings.

row.name: Board Game Engine
row.detailed_description: Normally the Editor would be paid, however since multiplayer has not been implemented we are allowing free access until we release the multiplayer update. You can buy the Editor early to support us, but note that it does not unlock additional features at this time. The Board Game Engine was built with game developers in mind as a tool for designing and prototyping your very own tabletop games with as much freedom as possible. Free to Play Play your favorite games or playtest upcoming titles for free! Pay only for the Editor. Game Editor A detailed game editor for creating your final prototypes. Everything you need to make your games can be found in the Game Editor, though dedicated editors are planned for all components. Modify core mechanics like players, hand limits, create a grid, or place snapping points for objects. Versioning Support All save types have versioning support, so you can switch between different versions of any type of save, even down to individual components. Update items of the same version in bulk inside the game editor. Deck Editor A dedicated deck editor, pulling together all saved cards into one simple UI for constructing decks. Steam Workshop Support Upload and download creations on the Steam Workshop. Free to play users can download from the Workshop too!
row.short_description: The Board Game Engine was built with game developers in mind as a tool for designing and prototyping your very own tabletop games with as much freedom as possible.

row.name: Eronoctosis: Put Yourself Together
row.detailed_description: A 2-Player Online Horror Co-Op game. 'What is this place...? Who are you? Who am I?' Explore the deepest recesses of your mind to put yourself back together. There is a meaning to this realm of madness, we must work together to escape. Content Warning Horrific, disturbing monsters. Pixelated genitalia. Ominous and oppressive atmosphere. Grab a friend and delve into the darkness.. Seek salvation, piece them together.
row.short_description: A 2-Player Networked Horror Co-Op game. Explore the deepest recesses of your mind to put yourself back together. Work together to defend yourself from its denizens.

row.name: RETROLD

row.short_description: In RETROLD you can play many games inspired by old arcades from 70`s, 80`s and even 90`s. (NEW GRAPHICS, NEW SONGS, NEW MECHANICS, OLD GAMES) :D

row.name: The Evil Farming Game: Replanted Playtest
Malyshka
row.detailed_description: Explore the village to your heart's content and meet its inhabitants: from kindly priests to eccentric toy collectors, the community is full of endearing characters to help you on your journey. Engage in their quests to retrieve the mysterious dolls, unearthing the enigma of your lost memories as you help the people of Tikyihavoda with their daily woes. Between puzzles, conferring, errands, and hunts, it all starts to come back to you...your wistful feelings may hold more water than you think. Explore Investigate Throw snowballs Chase bunnies Uncover the truth Malyshka is created by fifteen hardworking individuals under the R.A.T. Room collective. Comprised almost entirely of high schoolers, this team dedicated itself to the development of a humble but charming game. Story, art, writing, coding, voice acting, and beyond were shared among its members within the close community that formed over the course of its production. Fifteen art styles, fifteen creative visions, and fifteen minds all come together; overall, Malyshka is a labor of love, and a testament to youthful passion and the desire to grow and create. The R.A.T. (Really Artistically Talented) Room can be summarized by our group motto: “No think. Wing it.” As a collective, we work in collaboration to create animations, digital art, and video game projects. Our most recent game, titled Malyshka, displays the combined effort of about fifteen individuals who created all of the assets, story, dialogue, music, and programming. We are students, but we create as professionals. We have been able to foster a community full of diversity, inclusion, and creativity through our shared work and learning. Also, our grind doesn’t end when we leave the studio, everyone who is involved is constantly working hard to see our visions through to the end. At our core, the R.A.T. Room operates as a single unit. No one person is responsible for the work, we are a community co-op that is passionate about art and creativity.
row.short_description: From the sunken depths of a quiet lake, your heart pulls you to the surface; a doll awaits your ghostly form on the shore. Who are you? Why are you here? Discover the sleepy town of Tikhiyavoda, its community, and most of all, yourself.

row.name: The Plane Effect Prologue
row.detailed_description: A time-and-mind bending adventure game... It's your final day at the office, it is time to clock out and return home - loomed over by a cosmic anomaly with an oppressive, otherworldly force. Helpless over the cosmos, all you know is that you must return to your family, as soon as you can. Find your way home by any means... As you progress through the dystopic cityscape, you quickly you realise all is not as it should be. Did it always take this long? Were the streets always a labyrinth? Where even is 'home'? All you know is that you must keep pushing ever onwards, you must keep going. Navigate through a dystopian society Navigate beautifully and elaborately designed, otherworldly environments and solve unusual puzzles to keep Solo moving through each area. Players have the option to figure out puzzles step-by-step with no hints, or activate a little guidance on your impossible journey through 'Assisted-Mode'. A sinister presence follows Keep Solo moving. Onwards, to his family, back home. Do not stop, do not turn back.
row.short_description: Play the first 30 minutes of a dystopian isometric adventure, following a lonely office worker as he attempts to return home in the face of impossible odds. Experience a remarkable journey expertly brought to life with gorgeous visuals, crafted and tailored by VFX experts.

row.name: natsuno-kanata - beyond the summer
row.detailed_description: 'Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer' is released! NEW ARRIVALS! About the Game ── In the summer of the after apocalypse, the girl travels unaimlesly. 'natsuno-kanata - beyond the summer' A text adventure game depicting girls traveling the world to the end. You found an old computer which can connect to talk with strange garl you have never met. The girl's name is Natsuno. She said said to be traveling alone in a world collapsed by a pandemic. But in the world, you know, there is no pandemic or social collapse. Where is the world she is in and why are the calls connected each other? As you talk to Natsuno and watch over her journey, you will explore the mysteries of the end of the world. STORY Natsuno, a girl who leaves her hometown of Tokyo and continues traveling alone to the north. She is alone. She left her high school classmate at Tokyo,and got separeted separated from her parents at some station. After the train stopped working, she walked alone and continued her journey. She had'nt where to go and any purpose. The world has ended before half a year. An unprecedented pandemic has destroyed society in just a few moments. When infected, a person loses reason and becomes a monster cannot speak that attacks the person. Neither the causative virus nor the bacteria were finally revealed. People don't know anything. Still, what is in front of her is just reality, Even if she walks around the town, she don't meet anyone and have no choice but to continue her journey alone. You happened to talk to a girl traveling in such a world. It all started when you found an old computer,throught my grantmother's possessions after her death. Looking for memories with your grandmother, you opened the data on your computer. But what I heard from the computer was the voice of an unknown girl ── You dont know why but a call was connected to a girl who called herself Natsuno. Of course, there is no pandemic in the world you live in. High school students enjoy their summer vacation,they doesnt wandering around an empty town. Still, it's true that Natsuno and the call are connected. Where is she? Why can the call be connected? There were so many things I didn't understand, She just 'talk to me,' she said. While meeting other girls who live in a world that has ended, You gradually approach the truth ── CHARACTER Natsuno 'Hey, will you come with me?' A girl in the second year of high school. Leaving her hometown of Tokyo, she is traveling alone. She has the strength to survive alone,but She doesn't like herself so much that she gets used to everything. Akane 'Mmm. Don't cry like that, Natsuno-chan.' An elusive woman at her own pace. She lives with the gathered people for some reason before the collapse of the world. she seems to there is something to think about the pandemic that destroyed this world ... Kiko 'Wow! I'm sorry! Its not me!' She is a warm-hearted girl who travels alone in search of her stray dog. She's timid, but She has the strength of her will to continue traveling alone for her dog. Shino 'Unless such a situation, I can't travel alone, right?' She is a girl who travels in search of the location of the photo she found by chance. She's playfully looking for a place in a photo where she doesn't even know who took it. Her bright smile is impressive, but there seems to be a hidden feeling behind it ── STAFF Planning /Production /Scenario: Kazuhide Oka Character design: Chiji Original soundtrack: ruichiro Translator: NY
row.short_description: ── In the summer of the world that has ended, the girl travels aimlessly. 'natsuno-kanata - beyond the summer' is a text adventure game that depicts girls traveling in apocalypse. Through talking to the girls, we get to know them and approach the mysteries of the world ──

row.name: Two Clusters Cold Haven
row.detailed_description: Set in year 9791, Nicholas is a mercenary who works for an agency called 'The faceless'. One day, he takes on a job. It is a simple job on surface; he is to find a lost girl. However, that simple job drags him into troubles that he never expects to have. Features ➡️ At least 20 hours of game play. ➡️ An ability to pursue the main character's romantic interest. A player will have choices on whom and how far he will go. ➡️ An ability to unlock NFSW scenes. ➡️ A unique sci fi setting built on a novel. ➡️ Your choices will have game-altering consequences. ➡️ A mature plot.
row.short_description: Nicholas is a mercenary who takes on a seemingly simple job which drags him through more troubles than he expects.
row.notes: This game contains nudity, including full frontal nudity. Sexual acts and violence are also present. These include possible domestic violence.

row.name: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine is a side-scrolling Action-Adventure game that places an emphasis on player decisions. Featuring intricate storytelling, a vast world to explore, valuable crafting, and multiple endings to experience. This highly atmospheric game is filled with drama, mystery, and dread. This Prologue version of the final game is intended to give players the early experience of Rise of the Betrayer, introducing them to the world, the mechanics, and the story of Aidan's adventure. Wishlist the Full Game Now Crafting at the Core Part of overcoming the challenges in this world is learning to use all the tools you have at your disposal. One of the most valuable pieces of your toolkit is your ability to craft. Make potions to restore your health or to increase your strength. Make weapons to brutalize your enemies and armor to protect your tender bits. Deadly Platforming and Skilled Combat Not only will your wits be put to the test but your reflexes will as well. It's not all just stabby-stab. Run and jump your way to victory - and likely die trying, many times, before you succeed. Reveal the World of the Betrayer A land shrouded in darkness and mystery. Unlock the secrets of an ancient world and learn who you really are. Have we been here before? Multiple endings create high replayability. Come Heckle Us
row.short_description: Betrayer: Curse of the Spine - Prologue is an Action-Adventure Metroidvania. This is just a taste of the full game which will feature decision making, crafting, fast-paced combat, multiple endings, intricate storytelling, an open world to explore, and more!

row.name: Idle Heros
row.detailed_description: Welcome to 《IDLE HEROS》 Our world is being destroyed by the gods, and heroes are organizing to fight against it. Although it is a 2D game, but has super cool combat, strategic If you like the placement genre, give this game a try Unique hero IDLE HEROS currently has 27 heroes, and new heroes will be added in the future. Each hero has his own characteristic skill, 3 optional skills, and a powerful talent tree. Rich equipment attributes 《IDLE HEROS》There are many equipment attributes, equipment can be synthesized, different attributes can be matched with different heroes, there are many rare attributes, waiting for you to experience ~ Explore the unknown 《IDLE HEROS》Exploration gameplay is full of unknowns, rich rewards in exploration, can be synthesized, and rewards can be even richer after synthesis Risk group 《IDLE HEROS》can form a 5 member adventure party, get bonus stats and goodies, and invite your friends to join~
row.short_description: 《IDLE HEROS》 is a special placement game, invite your friends to form a fixed team, come to participate in the battle, placement can easily obtain a variety of resources

row.name: QuestNotes
row.detailed_description: QuestNotes is an MMOTRPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Table Talk RPG). As a player, you can not only explore the fantasy world of swords and sorcery. As a master, you can become a storyteller and create scenarios and sessions. Up to four players can form a party and adventure together. (There is also a private mode where you can play without other players. Players Choose one of the classes (wizards, thieves, etc.) and become an adventurer, accepting various requests (quests) and exploring various regions. As you complete quests, your character will grow and you can create your own original character. Quests created by other users are published on a daily basis, and you can choose to play a quest that suits your preference, whether it is combat-oriented or reading-oriented. Master You can create and publish stories and regions in the game with simple operations. You can also participate in quests that you have created with other players, and play sessions such as making monsters appear in real time.
row.short_description: QuestNotes is an MMOTRPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Table Talk RPG). As a player, you can not only explore the fantasy world of swords and sorcery. As a master, you can become a storyteller and create scenarios and sessions. Up to four players can form a party and adventure together.

row.name: Project: Vaccine A
row.detailed_description: 'Protect your CPU!' Build firewalls to protect your CPU, and build vaccines to keep malwares away! Protect your base with 200+ blocks, skills and upgrades! Restore your HP in Cleaner, Generate code files with Notepad, Watch full map with Web browser... Interact with various characteristic blocks! Noturn, A'vast... Upgrade various vaccines to protect your base. Earn exp every game and apply 60+ new perks. Meet familiar NPCs! Clippy, Rocky, Installation wizard... meet your old friends. Do you remember them? BOSS BATTLE! yes. i said boss battle. Boss battle every 6 waves! Fire everything you got! Test new strategy with Creative mode! Test various strategy and skills in Creative mode, where you can handle every settings! Firewall spamming? Boss battle without vaccine tool? Or... make your own mini-game? ※Every programs and parodies appear in this game is made with pure respect, and no copyright issues intended.
row.short_description: Firewall, vaccine, cleaner... Place various blocks to protect your CPU! Vaccine A is a sandbox defense game, filled with parody of various programs.

row.name: Fear Protocol: Shadow Paradigm
row.detailed_description: It's another nice dark day in Escondido, California and special agent Jack Banger goes from out of the frying pan and into the fire. The disgusting biomonster creatures are continuing to terrorize the city and there's only so much time before the plague spreads across the nation. The Night Striker Squad is all dead and now it's up to Banger to solve the biomonster crisis. Now, only one question remains... How to exterminate the biomonster threat? GENRE Tactical Espionage Thriller Mystery Box GAME INFO Become Jack Banger and make difficult choices, such as who lives and who dies. Master your arsenal of 5 weapons, and keep a keen eye out for mystical items such as crispy mushrooms. PROS  Is Short  High Octance Action  Dynamic Music System CONS  Is better than Banger 1  Defies Genre Stereotypes  Risotto
row.short_description: It's another nice dark day in Escondido, California and special agent Jack Banger goes from out of the frying pan and into the fire. The disgusting biomonster creatures are continuing to terrorize the city and there's only so much time before the plague spreads across the nation.
row.notes: Disturbing Biomonster Creatures, Violence, and Gore

row.name: Platformer::Execute();
row.detailed_description: You are a robot programmer whose objective is to reach the end of each level. Each level will have logic problems for you to solve, and it's up to you to build a path to the end of the level, with as few programming steps as possible. Look for efficiency each level has an optional objective, in which you should take into account the fewest steps your schedule should have.
row.short_description: This is a puzzle game platform, focused on completing each level using programming.

row.name: idolYAKI: From Delinquents to Pop Stars
row.detailed_description: Kazuo Tamara has always been a devout idol fan and is invited to be the fourth member of his school's new idol club. He is excited to meet up with other idol enthusiasts and gladly accepts, but on the first day, the only ones there are the three most dangerous delinquents at your school. They need your help transforming their images in order to become ideal pop stars and win the independent idol contest in Akihabara. A short game with six possible endings and lots of cute outfits. Try not to get on any of their bad sides, or you might face serious consequences.
row.short_description: Become friends or foes with the three most notorious criminals at your school as you help them transform into pop idols and compete in a nearby contest! A short, quick game with six possible endings!

row.name: Arena of Kings
row.detailed_description: COMMUNITY About the Game Experience MMORPG-style arena PvP in its purest form . Create your hero, customize your spells, and jump straight into 3v3 arena battles in a fight to the death! With no barrier to entry, there's nothing stopping you and your friends from joining our world. Play for FREE! 'The ultimate Esport game of raw skill, lightning-fast pace, teamwork, and strategy.' - Iverson, Bloodline Champions DreamHack World Champion ALL 10 CLASSES FREE Freedom of choice is a core pillar in our design. As a player, become empowered by the meaningful choices you make when theorycrafting your build. With over 150+ Spells available and only 8 fitting on your Spell Bar at a time, discover limitless combinations that directly impact the course of battle. BRING FRIENDS AND PARTY UP Solo Queue or Flex Queue in teams of 3 players. Precisely calibrated Skill-based Matchmaking ensures that you'll be matched against the right opponents every game. ASCENSION GAME MODE To the victor go the spoils! Consecutive victories increases your group's Bounty Value , advancing your party closer towards King's Ascent , a Continuous Global Tournament Event reserved for the two most dominant teams. Winning Ascension rewards epic treasure and a global shoutout heard across the Arena of Kings universe. FREQUENT GAME UPDATES We are dedicated to maintaining a healthy state of the game. Consistent game updates bring us closer to a more perfect state of balance. Seasonal content patches introduce new classes, spells, arenas, items, and fresh leaderboards to climb! FLUID MOVEMENT & OPTIMIZED NETCODE Lag ruins gaming . Our commitment to a smooth player experience experience is paramount. Experience instantly responsive movement , performance optimized high-tick servers , and gameplay fluidity that has been heavily QA tested with arena veterans. JOIN THE ARENA COMMUNITY!
row.short_description: ARENA OF KINGS is a fast-paced team arena brawler. Experience MMORPG-style combat without the grind. Create a hero from 10 unique classes. Level up, learn new spells, and collect epic loot. Casual, Ranked, and Tournament game modes. PLAY FOR FREE!

row.name: Lostria
row.detailed_description: Lostria is a competitive turn-based game set in the fantasy universe of the same name. Beta version The game is still in development and we plan to complete it before the end of the year. In the meantime yon can alredy play on the beta and playtest versions! Gameplay Build your team and compete against other players in Ranked or Friendly matches. Get rewards, unlock new characters and build even more specialized teams to lead you to victory. For the more creative ones, the map editor is at your disposal, show your artist and level designer skills to your friends. Come challenge players around the world and try to become the best strategist!
row.short_description: - BETA VERSION - Lostria is an online turn-based tactical game in a fantasy universe. Players build teams and compete among themself in tactical battles to become the best strategist in the world.

row.name: LAST CLOUDIA
row.detailed_description: Cinematic Effects and Sweeping Soundtrack A riveting tale told with pixel-art characters and 3D backgrounds, brought to life with lovingly crafted music and animation! White-knuckle Combat Action Heart-pounding real-time combat at a speed that's only possible with pixel art! Deep Character-building System Go beyond collecting strong characters—train your favorite characters to have the stats you want! It's all up to you! Hands-free autoplay No need to grind manually—just gear up your team and send them out to collect power-up materials! Star-studded Cast Of Voice actors Famous Japanese voice actors provide dynamic voices for characters in battle, when powering up, on the Home screen, and more! —story— Welcome to Granzelia, where people live among magical beasts. Long ago this world was tyrannically ruled by the God of Ruin, until the hero Adel and goddess Lilaha joined forces to seal it away. In the centuries since then, that hero's bloodline built the Aldana Empire to peacefully rule all the land—but lately changes are afoot. As reports of strange beast attacks surge, the 12th Order knight Kyle and the magical beast Rei set out on a mission. Neither knows it's the start of an epic battle that will shake the world! Swords, Sorcery, and Scintillating Combat! The Rpg Last Cloudia Has It All!
row.short_description: A fantasy RPG that weaves a sprawling tale with quirky characters and cinematic effects. Its gorgeous, fast-paced battles feature pixel art characters sweeping though 3D playspaces.
row.notes: The content of this game may not be appropriate for all ages. It contains fantasy battles, sporadic alcohol/ tobacco use, and criminal activity.

row.name: OneBit Adventure
row.detailed_description: OneBit Adventure is a casual turn-based roguelike where your adventure is a never-ending travel against rogue monsters. The further you go, the more difficult monsters will become, but the greater the loot and experience. Choose from a variety of classes and build the ultimate class, but be wary, OneBit is a very dangerous place full of untold mysteries. Explore various dungeons to loot and ascend your character to survive even longer! Your movement is your main action which can go 4 directions. Attack enemies by bumping into them and constantly moving that direction to attack. Collect coins to buy various items and once your level 15, you will be able to buy new skills from Wizard Sapius. Use these skills to help you battle through tougher foes and survive longer in your travels. Play as a Warrior, Blood knight, Wizard, Necromancer, Pyromancer, Archer or Thief. Each character has its own unique play style, abilities, and weakness. Unlock their true potential by leveling up which opens the world of active and passive skills that make every class unique. Complete various adventure quests and you can ascend your character to the next level. Prestige at level 100 and you will restart at level 1, but with permanently more skillpoints and more bonus XP. OneBit Adventure is a casual roguelike meaning the game is simple to play, but can be challenging the further you go. You have a limited amount of health and if your health reaches 0, its game over. Classic mode allows you to resurrect to continue while hardcore mode provides the ultimate permadeath experience and harder enemies to fight. The end of an adventure is a new beginning as completed adventures are submitted to Rankings where you can challenge your skills against thousands of others between steps traveled, kills and coins collected with Classic and Hardcore mode! OneBit Adventure is also available on Google Play and App Store with cross-sync compatibility! You can play on Steam and on mobile devices with 1 account. Simply load your account with your username and cloud ID and you are ready to switch between them seamlessly! Change the way OneBit Adventure looks completely with unlockable themes that makes the game fit to your liking. If you love 8-bit roguelikes and are looking for something casual to play, then you should consider OneBit Adventure right now. It's meant to be a simply fun experience where you can level up, play around with different combinations of weapons and skills to reach the furthest. It's a relaxing game, but also has leaderboards to compete with other OneBit players around the world! Features • Infinite world generation with 4+ unique dungeons • 6+ bosses to battle • 7+ classes with unique character builds at level 15 • 30+ unique equipment to use • 40+ monsters to battle • Competitive worldwide leaderboard with premium rewards • Cross platform with Android, iOS, and Steam • Hardcore mode for true roguelike experience
row.short_description: OneBit Adventure is a casual turn-based roguelike where you adventure as far as possible to level up and battle against rogue monsters. Your primary goal in OneBit Adventure is to survive and loot. Choose from a variety of classes and build the ultimate class.

row.name: B.Y.O.O.L. - Best Years Of Our Lives
row.detailed_description: A visual novel about love, full of odd humor, dark humor, meta humor and hopefully, heart. Join Nastya, Aya, Rose and Shawna as they go on a dark, surreal adventure that will change their life forever. This kinetic novel will take you about 40 minutes to complete, making it a good way to pass the time if you're short on it.
row.short_description: A visual novel about love, full of odd humor, dark humor, meta humor and hopefully, heart. Join Nastya Byool as she goes on a dark, surreal adventure that will change her life forever. This kinetic novel will take you about 40 minutes, making it a good way to pass the time if you're short on it.
row.notes: Suicide, alcohol, abortion and mental illness are all brought up at some point, in comedic fashion or otherwise. Game contains mild cartoon violence in one scene. The dialogue can be mildly suggestive.

row.name: Battlegrounds : First Blast
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Battlegrounds takes the best part of roguelites, tower-defense, strategy and action genres and fuses them to create an enticing gameplay experience with easy to understand mechanics. The player must defend his home base from enemy tanks by quickly brainstorming good strategies, unlocking and upgrading machines and making the best use of every new environment present. Highly Replayable Awesome soundtracks Unlock and upgrade special vehicles Explore various strategies and playstyles Unlock achievements
row.short_description: A military styled action tower-defense game filled with nukes, missiles and tanks. Improve your building, canons and tanks. Purchase stronger ammunition and survive the next wave. Highly replayable, tough and addictive. The fun never ends

row.name: All Dream Long A Flower Storm
row.detailed_description: A whimsical, award-winning point-and-click visual novel adventure game from the creators of HUNGRY TEA PARTY and My Dear Frankenstein. Relax into a dreamscape alongside a friendly, hungry demon called Baku. Explore a world made of fairytales, traditional Japanese legends, classic Western literature, and peculiar scenery where real-life physics doesn't apply. Solve riddles and puzzles to help colorful characters, some human, some not. But be warned... the further you go into your dream, the less you may want to wake up. Play time: About 2 hours Endings: 4 (three normal, one true end) Release date (in Japanese): March 25, 2019 (in Korean): April 23, 2020 (in English): August 20, 2021 Made with: Tyranobuilder and Tyranoscript Silver Prize winner in the Tyrano Game Festival 2019.
row.short_description: Award-winning point-and-click game FREE to download and play! Relax into a dreamscape full of fairytales, legends, and peculiar scenery. With the help of friendly demon Baku, solve riddles and puzzles to reach the true end and wake up... if you want to wake up, that is.
row.notes: Please note this game contains references to prejudice, illness and injury, and characters being trapped; text-only descriptions of violence; and fantasy characters and situations.

row.name: Spirit of Europe - Origins
row.detailed_description: The Spirit of Europe - Origins is a free edutainment jRPG independent game, developed in Unreal Engine 4. Embody a fragment of the mythical Europa and travel through history from the ancient times to the Renaissance, through the realm of thoughts and emotions, where spirits fight for supremacy over human consciousness. Experience a humanistic metaphor of historical events as we know them, possess over a hundred characters, drive their actions and witness their consequences in pivotal events of Europe’s past. Warning We would like to underline that this product is an indie effort, so please set your expectations accordingly. Features : ● Free; ● Historically accurate educational content; ● Two realms: the spirit realm and the material one; ● Possession system, allowing you to take control of any NPC; ● Economy and building system used to upgrade and recruit units; ● Disciples II-inspired, tactical, turn-based combat; ● A deeply philosophical, fictional story-line involving gods, virtues, vices, concepts and thoughts, manifested as spirits; ● Over 15 hours of gameplay; ● 58 combat units with over 50 unique abilities; ● Over 240 NPCs to interact with, from ancient Greece to the 12th century European Renaissance; ● 13 unique maps offering over 20 quests; ● Possess & explore the world with over 240 characters, from mere commoners to great figures of European history. Experience history with a twist : The perspectives of Gods, personalized virtues and vices are different from those of mere mortals in the spirit world we’ve built inspired by archetypal stories, western philosophy and core principles which the modern western society is built on: peace, democracy, rule of law, freedom, tolerance, pluralism - and we’ll let you discover the rest. Discover the forging of Europe & the birth of the western ethos : Possess any mortal, be it a mere commoner or a great figure of history. Drive their actions and learn about their way of life, beliefs, fears and hopes, aspirations and ambition - and you may be surprised at what you uncover. Assemble your troops & manage your resources : Gain influence with the living and inspire them to build the great edifices we know today. Gather the souls of defeated vices and use them to summon allies from among those fallen throughout the ages. Augment them with godly essences for they will be your shield against the forces that seek your undoing - and you will witness how the bitterest foes can become allies. By your hand shall history be made : Be the invisible hand that forges Europe’s history as we know it: from the ancient times of Classical Greece, throughout the glory of the Roman Empire, the tumult of its fall, the chaos that followed and the bonds formed in the Middle Ages. Your journey through Europe will only end once it’s reborn - or will it?
row.short_description: An edutainment jRPG experience, spanning from ancient Greece to the 12th century European Renaissance, brimming with historically-accurate characters and events, experienced through two realms: of spirits, thoughts and emotions, and the material world.

row.name: Your Adventure
row.detailed_description: This demo and listing are old! If you're looking to play the new and improved demo for TeleCollision, with new features, level designs, puzzles, and story elements, check out and play that demo! It has much more content than this Your Adventure demo! Create a custom character, and be whoever you want to be! A space princess? A mighty warrior? An office drone? A half angel half demon jousting champion? Then set off on Your Adventure, in one of three genres! A medieval realm of dark mysteries, a space station in deep space with roguish characters, and a school for the supernaturally gifted. Will you save the trinity of realities? Stop the murder on the space express? Fall in love with the dreamy supernatural entity? Or reality hop and enjoy a variety of different experiences? Enjoy traversing strange worlds, making friends, and mastering action command combat as you fight strange and odd and weird enemies and bosses! Remember, this is your adventure! Features: Character Customization Custom pronouns, don't worry about picking a gender Each of the three genres is a unique level Customize your play style with different equipment loads A few music tracks made by the guy who made everything else, who doesn't know how to write music Lots of music tracks made by someone else who does know how to write music Large words used usually improperly A tiny cowboy just trying to get ahead in life Reality Television Lots of jokes you might find endearing
row.short_description: Create a custom character, and be whoever you want to be! Enjoy traversing strange worlds, and mastering action command combat as you fight strange and odd and weird enemies and bosses! Remember, this is your adventure!

row.name: 13:ORIGIN - Prologue
row.detailed_description: When you wake up in the mental institute you're in charge of, you realize you've been locked in your room by your most dangerous (and clever) patient. Will you be able to reach the way out while taking the journal you found in your room and stepping into an ancient story? 13:Origin - Prologue is a kind of preview of our game called '13:Origin' , which we aim to release soon. With this prologue, you will be able to experience the storyline we aim for and some of our different, unique and satisfying puzzles. 13:Origin offers you more than just a mechanical puzzle-solving experience. You'll need to leverage the mechanics, the story, your instincts, and most importantly, 'doubt' to solve puzzles meticulously crafted for you. IMERSIVE AND ORGANIC STORY 13:Origin - Prologue offers you a unique story that you have not experienced before and the tense atmosphere created by that story. SECRETS TO DISCOVER As you solve these unique puzzles, you also uncover a secret that has been around since the beginning of mankind. MINIMALIST INTERFACE We do not want to confuse your mind even more, which is already sufficiently entangled with stories and puzzles. The interface and gameplay were thought as minimalist as possible.
row.short_description: 13: Origin is a web of clues that you must follow and not miss, as in most room escape/puzzle games. As you untie each knotted loop, you will realize how long and endless the thread you hold on to the end is.

row.name: 20b
row.detailed_description: Description: Unlike her parents, all Sookie’s ever wanted is to live a normal and quiet life . She isn’t interested in getting wrapped up in other people’s business and instead chooses to live life as a background character. As just another cog in the machine. Unseen and unheard. Unfortunately for her, she’s plagued with bad luck . Outside of getting into a whole host of colorful, cartoon-like accidents, Sookie’s poor luck manifests itself in scenarios that thrust her into the limelight, actively working against her goal of being on the sidelines of life. So much so that upon arriving at her new and mysterious school, Sookie is offered an ultimatum by the Principal. “Defeat the seven MISFITS or face expulsion” What started out with Sookie wanting to live peacefully ends up devolving into utter pandemonium. Amongst the madness of this hour-long, globe-trotting visual novel, will our poor protagonist ever catch a break? Features: Free Short, kinetic visual novel with a unique structure and blistering pace From New York to Paris, to Cairo and Rome... Live a life as you travel across the world and battle your new classmates Mingle with a cast of dozens! From the strange and zany to the cryptic and unknown as you try to get away from it all Original soundtrack ...and more!
row.short_description: Eight peculiar students, a pair of highly-trained assassins, extraterrestrials plotting a full-scale invasion of Earth, a secret society on the verge of toppling the US presidency and a Doomsday cult gearing to wipe California off the map.

row.name: 武者斗天师
row.detailed_description: 该游戏的1.0正式版本已于2022年6月中旬更新，具备练习模式和PVE模式各一个关卡，开放三个职业中的两个职业——天师和斗士。 此游戏参考了流星蝴蝶剑、火影忍者以及鬼泣系列，主要期望以独特的玩法于当前主流的战斗机制外，再创一种全新的战斗机制（舍弃快捷键和搓招的方式），该机制的战斗系统大体分为三种方向——即时战斗系统、半即时战斗系统和延时战斗系统，分别对应武者、斗者以及天师三种职业方向。另外，本作风格暂定偏向于武侠写实风格，玩法则参考《流星蝴蝶剑》局域网对战为主，辅以不同关卡来讲述剧情，最终形成以玩法创新为主的中小体量的游戏。 1) 核心机制 -延时攻击战斗系统 原理：选择-判断-释放：选择利用鼠标键的左右之分进行位运算，直至确定技能，并选择恰当的时机释放。 特点：天师职业最大的特点在于可以装备足够多的技能进行攻击、防御以及人物的状态改变，理论最多可装备512种的技能。 -半即时战斗系统 原理：滑步进/退-攻击并记录键位-判断并释放技能，追加攻击伤害并附加攻击效果。 特点：斗者的攻击方式为天师与武者两者的结合，使用独有的滑步，讲究进退之间接近敌人或闪避敌人的攻击，既有武者高机动能力，又有天师可装备多种技能的能力。 -即时攻击战斗系统 原理：利用键位的组合变化自由转换可以随意切入或脱离战斗，使之能够达到攻击的流畅性与繁复多变，包括但不止位置变幻和附加攻击效果。 特点：引入类似《只狼》和《拳皇》的防反机制和特有的变招系统，讲究攻防一体，能力较为均衡且操作简单流畅，如：         剑法的击、刺、格、洗、劈、砍、撩、提、抽、带、崩、点等；         刀法的劈、砍、刺、格、扎、撩等；         枪法的扎、刺、挞、抨、缠、圈、拦、拿、扑、点、拨、舞花等；         棍法的剃、滚、劈、扫、冲、撞、捣、杵、捅、撩等； 2)游戏模式        类似《流星蝴蝶剑》的PVP玩法（初期）；        类似《怪物猎人》的PVE玩法（中期拓展）； 3) 项目详情 目前，整个项目已由我个人独立开发一年有余，期望能够有志同道合的人一起搞事情。
row.short_description: 该Demo 参考了流星蝴蝶剑、火影忍者以及鬼泣系列，以独特的玩法于当前主流的战斗机制外，再创一种全新的战斗机制（舍弃快捷键和搓招的方式），该机制的战斗系统大体分为三种方向——即时战斗系统、半即时战斗系统和延时战斗系统，分别对应武者、斗者以及天师三种职业方向。目前，具备练习模式和PVE模式各一个关卡，开放三个职业中的两个职业——天师和斗士。

row.name: Yearning: A Gay Story
row.detailed_description: Yearning: A Gay Story (YAGS for short) is a realistic coming-out-focused character-driven slice-of-life visual novel where you play as a gay man starting his freshman year of college at a generic university somewhere in the midwestern United States. The game features dating sim elements, but is not focused on them. You will interact with a cast of characters, each with their own personality and stories, as you navigate college life, develop friendships, play board games, and come out. With luck, you might even find a boyfriend. A world where you can befriend people and see events from different perspectives, depending on your decisions 4 dateable guys* with their own distinct stories, with good and bad endings for each guy (9 endings in all*) 230,000+ words and meaningful choices Collectibles system to track and reward your decisions Achievements, for completionists Unlockable in-game character profiles An original soundtrack featuring 'Yearning', the YAGS theme * Or are there? Looking for more gay romance? Zen: A Gay Sequel takes place after the end of YAGS, this time from Carlos' perspective!
row.short_description: Yearning: A Gay Story (YAGS) is a realistic coming-out-focused character-driven slice-of-life visual novel where you play as a gay man starting his freshman year of college at a generic university somewhere in the midwestern United States.
row.notes: This is not an explicit game. Sex is neither shown nor explicitly described. However, the game does feature strong language, adult situations, nudity, and implied (gay) sex, as well as discussions of sex and sexuality.

row.name: Idle Monkeylogy
row.detailed_description: VERY ECCENTRIC IDLE GAME HERE! Idle Monkeylogy is a clicker-idle game that is based on The infinite monkey theorem in which a monkey infinitely types the keyboard randomly to complete Shakespeare's work. Features Type as monkeys do! You have to type randomly to complete the word! And later, you will be able to make the monkeys type! Fruits Gathering As monkeys type they get hungry. Shake the tree to get some apples! You need enormous amount of apples for typing a lot. Upgrades Various upgrade for monkeys for better income! Later, it will also make monkeys type automatically so let's get more and more words! [Making a dictionary] You can make a dictionary made of words you and monkeys completed! [Ascending] You start the game from beginning with a lot of new upgrades! [Challenge] Make your monkeys grow and challenge the sentences with too many letters! Try how strong your monkeys are! row.short_description: IDLE GAME based on the Infinite Monkey Theorem

row.name: Incremental Epic Hero 2
row.detailed_description: Incremental Epic Hero 2 (IEH2) is the sequel to the original Incremental Epic Hero . Don’t worry if you haven’t played the first game—you can fully enjoy this one without any prior experience! This game is an Incremental/Idle RPG crafted by a Japanese developer. After 2.5 years of Early Access (beta), we are thrilled to announce its full release! With countless updates based on feedback and ideas from our players, this game has been polished to its current state. We hope you enjoy it! Explore the World of IEH2! In IEH2, you control six unique heroes as they adventure through a vast fantasy world. With over 1,000 hours of gameplay content, the journey never truly ends. Dive in and explore the immersive world of IEH2 at your own pace—it’s a game designed to grow with you. Automated Battles Your heroes automatically move, attack, heal, and perform other actions, ensuring nonstop battles! By progressing through Rebirth , you can eventually manage all heroes simultaneously in the background. With over 100 unique monsters, 200+ pieces of equipment and items, and countless quests to complete, an exciting journey awaits! A Vast World Map The expansive world of IEH2 is filled with colorful monsters, including slimes, bats, unicorns, and more. Each area and dungeon features prestige mechanics, keeping your adventures fresh and exciting, no matter how many times you revisit them. Town Building Build various structures like the 'Statue of Heroes,' 'Cartographer,' and 'Alchemist's Hut' to upgrade your game’s functions. Design and grow your own personalized town! Rich Gameplay Elements Share unique skills among your six heroes to create dynamic strategies. Capture over 100 monsters and enhance their abilities through leveling up to strengthen your team. Brew dozens of potions through alchemy and empower your gear endlessly with enchanting scrolls. Collect, enhance, and refine over 200 pieces of equipment and items to bolster your heroes’ power. Rebirth your heroes to gain powerful progression boosts, starting fresh but stronger each time. Prestige the entire world through Ascension , unlocking even more content and stronger boosts. Challenge yourself with brand-new, high-stakes battle modes. Connect with the Developer! We actively incorporate feedback from players through our Discord community. The developer is Japanese, so feel free to reach out in Japanese! (Developer account name: Hitan )
row.short_description: A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore, where battling is constant, almost everything can be upgraded, and with wide array of various prestige mechanics to always keep things interesting and moving forward!

row.name: Incremental Cubes
row.detailed_description: This is a simple but very deep incremental game! All you need is to collect more cubes and keep going! 〇Overview Collect cubes, defeat enemies, and advance through the tiers. 〇Simple Upgrades Each cube has an upgrade that reduces the interval at which the cubes fall. 〇Prestige Prestige will reset all your progress, but it boosts the progress dramatically. You can buy a lot of skills from a 3D-like skill tree! The skill points needed to buy skills can be gained by attacking enemies. 〇Helpers As you progress through the game, helpers who will attack enemies and collect cubes for you will appear. 〇Boss Battle As you progress through the game, bosses will appear periodically. Bosses are hard to beat, but when you beat them, your current cube will change into a larger one. In addition, you can earn more skill points than usual. 〇Challenge Challenge mode will be unlocked as you progress through the game. Clearing challenges will give you super bonuses that will help you advance in the game. 〇Controls Mouse only.
row.short_description: Cube based incremental game that is simple but very deep!

row.name: Maximum Football
row.detailed_description: 2 Leagues. 1 Universe. Your Terms. Forge your legacy in Maximum Football, where you can play both college and pro football in one shared universe. Fully customize your team and build your dream roster to play solo or take it to the gridiron in local or online multiplayer. In Maximum Football, you have ultimate control over football simulation. FOOTBALL ON YOUR TERMS Don't just play the game, build it. Maximum Football’s deep customization suite gives you the power to create a unique identity. Craft the perfect helmet and jersey combination, use custom logos, and edit every detail of your roster to dominate the competition. Modify every piece of your football universe the way you want it, from league sizes to the rulesets. BUILD A COLLEGE DYNASTY In Dynasty Mode, you'll take the reins as head coach, scouring the nation for top recruits, developing their talent, and making the strategic decisions that lead to championships. You also take on the responsibilities of your school’s Athletic Director, where you upgrade and manage your stadium and facilities, as well as every detail of your school. This is a deep, multi-season experience for any college football fanatic. RUN A PRO FRANCHISE Try your hand at managing a pro team by building your roster from free agency and the draft, running the front office and stadium amenities, and making the game-time decisions to cement your franchise into a league leader. Connect Dynasty Mode with Franchise Mode to build one football universe, where you can draft your college superstars onto your pro roster. AUTHENTIC FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY Powered by the Unreal Engine 5, every snap is brought to life with our physics-based gameplay system. Feel the weight of every collision and experience the freedom of realistic player animations. This is football where your skill on the sticks truly matters. Play today for free!
row.short_description: Forge your legacy in Maximum Football, where you can play both college and pro football in one shared universe. Recruit the next college superstar and take them into the pros to become a future Hall of Famer. Build your team with unparalleled in-game customization that gives you ultimate control.

row.name: The Market of Light
row.detailed_description: Notice - 09/29/2021 The game will launch at the resolution set on your PC. If the resolution is set to higher than full HD and the frame rate gets too low, you can try either of the following methods to lock the resolution to full HD. -At the title screen, follow the guide at the bottom right and enter the F key. -In the exit menu, follow the guide at the bottom right and enter the F key. This is a short game and tech demo created with the early access build of Unreal Engine 5. The player is a firefly that collects orbs of light scattered around the market. Play time: 15 - 30 minutes A small-town marketplace seems huge from the perspective of a tiny firefly. Experience a meticulously rendered world from a micro view point! Inspired by the excitement of the announcement by Unreal Engine 5, we created this game. 'Nanite' handles unlimited polygons, 'Lumen', which allows for perfectly dynamic lighting, and the latest visual effect tool, 'Niagara'. Even one would have been sensational, but it's a major event to have all of them come out at almost the same time. Tech Demo Highlights Super close-up presentation Dynamic sunlight changes Progressive visual effects -Film-quality assets can be used with almost no modification The 3 colors of light represent Nanite, Lumen, and Niagara. This game features next-generation representations of these new functions. We live in an interesting time, a turning point of technology, enjoy it with us!
row.short_description: A short game and tech demo created with Unreal Engine 5. The player is a small firefly that collects orbs of light scattered around the market. Experience a meticulously rendered world from a micro view point!

row.name: Monster Wilds
row.detailed_description: DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A STUDENT GAME, PLAYERS ARE BOUND TO ENCOUNTER SOME BUGS AND ISSUES DURING GAMEPLAY. In the Monster Wilds, there is a hierarchy. The largest, most powerful monsters rule the largest swaths of territory, leaving less powerful monsters to the Wild Woods and surrounding areas. Where does that leave Doppels? Hiding, praying they’ll be able to eat and live. The player is one such doppel, a rare color among other blue doppels; one of those parasites who subsists off of monster carcasses and monsters big enough not to notice the stab of their horn. One day, the pink Doppel notices that if they stab right into the spinal cord under the monster cranium, they see flashes of the monster’s anatomy, and gain more than an understanding of their abilities; the player gains the ability itself. Others of its species simply survive; the player starts to realize that this constraint on their species could evaporate if Doppel were to teach them. The Doppel ventures forth, taking down small prey and learning abilities that will aid the whole of the Doppel species. When he returns, other doppels herald him a pioneer of another way of life—a hero. With the rising number of monsters that Doppel conquers, he begins to realize that he can combine abilities of monsters of similar level to become stronger. With each ability harvested, the doppel species becomes less and less afraid of the Wilds, and more lustful for adventure, with the pink Doppel at the helm of their expeditions. Doppel only wants to go farther; if it can only take on bigger monsters, it could become more powerful. And with power, comes respect. No longer will the player or their species be bottom-feeding parasites. They are ready to thrive. Play as Doppel, and battle your way through the Monster Wilds to become the ultimate Monster!
row.short_description: Play as Doppel, the adorable shapeshifting blob, and battle your way through the Monster Wilds to become the ultimate Monster! Fight all kinds of unique enemies and explore a number of strikingly designed levels. DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A STUDENT GAME.

row.name: Wolf At Evergreen
row.detailed_description: ** A Research-Based VR Demo from 2021 ** This VR experience was made as a part of the research component of a Master's degree for Rebecca Kerr with special thanks given to Curtin University and the talented voice actors who helped bring the characters to life. The initial release was submitted as part of the degree, with subsequential updates to improve user interactions and any bugs. ****** Please Note: As of July 14, 2022, this demo has received its final update and will not receive further updates. It remains available for all to enjoy in its current state. A big thank you to all those who supported this project! ****** ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE Wolf At Evergreen (originally Unnatural Freaks) is a VR interactive narrative experience, where you play as Frankie, an investigator who's a part of an online vlog series. Frankie’s role is to investigate rumours of supernatural/paranormal experiences to determine their truth and then make a video log about it. In this demo, Frankie investigates several werewolf sightings in the small town of Evergreen. By talking with the townspeople and exploring the museum, clues will emerge.
row.short_description: **A Research Demo from 2021** A supernatural-mystery, interactive-narrative VR experience. Are the rumours of a werewolf sighting true? Talk with townspeople and explore the museum to discover what's truly happening in the small town of Evergreen.
